params.body: With X-Timing-Detail the response also carries X-Explain-1 and X-Explain-2: the MariaDB plan of the two slowest SELECTs (table, access type, key, rows, extra per step). Needed because after #178 and #179 the two list statements still take 700 ms each and the SQL text alone does not say which step scans.
params.title: Server-Timing detail: query plans
